connector.name: Freeagent MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: FreeAgent accounting MCP: bank reconciliation, expenses, mileage claims and receipts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package freeagent-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oxygenbubbles account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: ORS_API_KEY

env.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
env.description: Google Maps API key (alternative to ORS for distance calculation)
